    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders(request, env) });

    // This makes the HTML and server API a single deployable JavaScript file.

      if ((request.method === "GET" || request.method === "HEAD") && (url.pathname === "/" || url.pathname === "/index.html")) {
        if (cacheableHome && edgeCache && homeCacheKey) {
          try { const cachedHome = await edgeCache.match(homeCacheKey); if (cachedHome) return cachedHome; } catch (_) { /* Cache is an optional performance layer. */ }
        }

        const swiftBic = String(env.BARID_SWIFT_BIC || "").trim();
        const swiftAccount = String(env.BARID_SWIFT_ACCOUNT || "").trim();

        if (swiftBic) site = site.replace("Not configured — confirm the official BIC/SWIFT with Barid Bank", htmlSafe(swiftBic));
        if (swiftAccount) site = site.replace("Use only the account details confirmed by Barid Bank for international incoming transfers", htmlSafe(swiftAccount));
        if (swiftIntermediary) site = site.replace("Confirm with Barid Bank for the transfer currency; do not guess intermediary-bank details", htmlSafe(swiftIntermediary));

      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Platform memory database is not configured." }, 503);
      if (request.method === "GET") {
        const result = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT memory_key, value_json, description, revision, updated_at, updated_by FROM platform_memory ORDER BY memory_key LIMIT 500").all();
        return json(request, env, { success: true, count: (result.results || []).length, entries: (result.results || []).map(r => ({ key:r.memory_key, value:JSON.parse(r.value_json), description:r.description, revision:r.revision, updatedAt:r.updated_at, updatedBy:r.updated_by })) });
      }
      const parsed = await readJsonLimited(request, 20000);
      if (parsed.error) return json(request, env, { success:false, message: parsed.error === "too_large" ? "Memory entry exceeds the size limit." : "Invalid JSON." }, parsed.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsed.value || {};
      const key = safeString(body.key, 100);
      const description = safeString(body.description, 300);
      if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{0,99}$/.test(key)) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Invalid memory key." }, 400);
      if (/secret|password|token|credential|private.?key|otp|recovery/i.test(key + " " + description)) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Do not store secrets or authentication credentials in platform memory." }, 400);
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(body, "value")) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"A value is required." }, 400);
      const valueJson = JSON.stringify(body.value);
      if (valueJson.length > 12000) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Memory value is too large (12 KB maximum per entry)." }, 413);
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      const previous = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT revision FROM platform_memory WHERE memory_key = ?").bind(key).first();
      const revision = Number(previous?.revision || 0) + 1;
      const actor = "admin";
      const saved = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO platform_memory (memory_key,value_json,description,revision,updated_at,updated_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(memory_key) DO UPDATE SET value_json=excluded.value_json, description=excluded.description, revision=excluded.revision, updated_at=excluded.updated_at, updated_by=excluded.updated_by")
        .bind(key, valueJson, description || null, revision, now, actor).run();
      if (!saved.success) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Could not save platform memory." }, 500);
      const history = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO platform_memory_history (memory_key,revision,value_json,description,changed_at,changed_by) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)")
        .bind(key, revision, valueJson, description || null, now, actor).run();
      if (!history.success) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Current value saved, but revision history failed. Check D1 and retry backup." }, 500);
      return json(request, env, { success:true, key, revision, updatedAt:now, message:"Platform memory saved." }, 201);
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/platform-memory/backup" && request.method === "GET") {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Unauthorized." }, 401);
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success:false, message:"Platform memory database is not configured." }, 503);
      const current = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT memory_key, value_json, description, revision, updated_at, updated_by FROM platform_memory ORDER BY memory_key").all();
      const history = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT memory_key, revision, value_json, description, changed_at, changed_by FROM platform_memory_history ORDER BY memory_key, revision").all();
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ service:"Marrakechpixim Platform Memory", exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(), entries:current.results||[], history:history.results||[] }, null, 2), { status:200, headers:{...corsHeaders(request,env),"Content-Type":"application/json; charset=utf-8","Content-Disposition":"attachment; filename= marrakechpixim-platform-memory-backup.json".replace("filename= ","filename="),"Cache-Control":"no-store","X-Content-Type-Options":"nosniff"} });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/paypal/config" && request.method === "GET") {
      // MPX-8238: return a safe, non-secret config response even before PayPal setup.
      const configuredOrigin = normalizeOrigin(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN);
      const sameOrigin = Boolean(configuredOrigin && configuredOrigin === new URL(request.url).origin);
      const hasDatabase = Boolean(env.DB);
      const hasClientId = Boolean(String(env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID || "").trim());
      const hasClientSecret = Boolean(String(env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET || "").trim());
      const enabledFlag = String(env.PAYPAL_ENABLED || "false").toLowerCase() === "true";
      const enabled = enabledFlag && hasDatabase && hasClientId && hasClientSecret && Boolean(sameOrigin);
      const mode = String(env.PAYPAL_MODE || "sandbox").toLowerCase() === "live" ? "live" : "sandbox";
      return json(request, env, {
        success: true,
        enabled,
        configured: { database: hasDatabase, clientId: hasClientId, clientSecret: hasClientSecret, allowedOrigin: Boolean(sameOrigin), enabledFlag },
        clientId: enabled ? String(env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID) : "",
        mode,
        currency: PAYPAL_CURRENCY,
        products: [
          { id: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["digital-mini-consultation"].id, name: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["digital-mini-consultation"].name, amount: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["digital-mini-consultation"].amount, currency: PAYPAL_CURRENCY },
          { id: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["project-support-donation"].id, name: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["project-support-donation"].name, allowedAmounts: PAYPAL_PRODUCTS["project-support-donation"].allowedAmounts, currency: PAYPAL_CURRENCY }
        ],
        message: enabled ? "Required PayPal settings are present. Credentials and checkout are not verified by this endpoint; complete a Sandbox create-order, approve and capture test before considering live mode." : "PayPal is inactive. Configure D1, PayPal credentials as Worker secrets, and ALLOWED_ORIGIN as the exact HTTPS origin. Keep PAYPAL_ENABLED=false until Sandbox create-order, approval and capture have all passed."
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/paypal/create-order" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (!paymentOriginAllowed(request, env)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Origin not allowed. Open checkout from the official Marrakechpixim website." }, 403);
      if (String(env.PAYPAL_ENABLED || "false").toLowerCase() !== "true") return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "PayPal checkout is not enabled by the administrator yet." }, 503);
      if (!env.DB || !env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID || !env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET || !String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN || "").trim() || String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN).trim() === "*") return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "PayPal credentials, payment storage, or exact allowed website origin are not configured." }, 503);
      const length = Number(request.headers.get("Content-Length") || 0);
      if (length > 3000) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Request is too large." }, 413);
      const parsedBody = await readJsonLimited(request, 3000);
      if (parsedBody.error) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? "Request is too large." : "Invalid checkout request." }, parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsedBody.value;
      const product = resolvePayPalProduct(body);
      if (!product) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unknown payment purpose or unsupported amount. Choose a listed option; the server controls all prices." }, 400);
      const clientIp = request.headers.get("CF-Connecting-IP") || "unknown";
      const ipHash = await sha256Hex(clientIp);
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
      const recent = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM payments WHERE ip_hash = ? AND created_at > ?").bind(ipHash, since).first();
      if (Number(recent?.total || 0) >= 8) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Too many checkout attempts. Please wait 10 minutes and try again." }, 429);
      const paymentId = crypto.randomUUID();
      const reference = makePaymentReference();
      const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const mode = String(env.PAYPAL_MODE || "sandbox").toLowerCase() === "live" ? "live" : "sandbox";
      const inserted = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO payments (payment_id, reference, product_id, amount, currency, status, ip_hash, mode, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'creating', ?, ?, ?, ?)")
        .bind(paymentId, reference, product.id, product.amount, product.currency, ipHash, mode, createdAt, createdAt).run();
      if (!inserted.success) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Could not create a secure payment record. No payment was taken." }, 500);
      try {
        const token = await paypalAccessToken(env);
        const order = await paypalApi(env, token, "/v2/checkout/orders", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "PayPal-Request-Id": crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "").slice(0, 32) },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            intent: "CAPTURE",
            purchase_units: [{ reference_id: product.id, description: product.description, custom_id: paymentId, invoice_id: reference, amount: { currency_code: product.currency, value: product.amount } }],
            application_context: { brand_name: "Marrakechpixim", user_action: "PAY_NOW", shipping_preference: "NO_SHIPPING", return_url: `${new URL(request.url).origin}/#mode-de-paiement`, cancel_url: `${new URL(request.url).origin}/#mode-de-paiement` }
          })
        });
        if (!order.id || !Array.isArray(order.links)) throw new Error("PayPal did not return a checkout order.");
        const savedOrder = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE payments SET paypal_order_id = ?, status = 'created', updated_at = ? WHERE payment_id = ? AND status = 'creating'")
          .bind(order.id, new Date().toISOString(), paymentId).run();
        if (!savedOrder.success) throw new Error("Could not save the PayPal order in the payment database.");
        const verifiedOrder = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT paypal_order_id, status FROM payments WHERE payment_id = ?").bind(paymentId).first();
        if (verifiedOrder?.paypal_order_id !== order.id || verifiedOrder?.status !== "created") throw new Error("The PayPal order could not be reconciled with the payment record.");
        return json(request, env, { success: true, orderId: order.id, reference, status: "created" }, 201);
      } catch (error) {
        await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE payments SET status = 'failed', error_code = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE payment_id = ?")
          .bind(safeString(error.paypalIssue || "ORDER_CREATE_FAILED", 80), new Date().toISOString(), paymentId).run();
        return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "PayPal could not create checkout. No successful payment has been recorded. Please try again later." }, 502);
      }
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/paypal/cancel-order" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (!paymentOriginAllowed(request, env)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Origin not allowed." }, 403);
      if (String(env.PAYPAL_ENABLED || "false").toLowerCase() !== "true" || !env.DB || !String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN || "").trim() || String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN).trim() === "*") return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "PayPal checkout is not configured." }, 503);
      const parsedBody = await readJsonLimited(request, 1000);
      if (parsedBody.error) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? "Request is too large." : "Invalid cancellation request." }, parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsedBody.value;
      const orderId = safeString(body.orderID, 100);
      if (!/^[A-Z0-9-]{8,100}$/i.test(orderId)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Invalid PayPal order ID." }, 400);
      const payment = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT payment_id, status FROM payments WHERE paypal_order_id = ? LIMIT 1").bind(orderId).first();
      if (!payment) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "This PayPal order is not registered with Marrakechpixim." }, 404);
      if (payment.status === "paid") return json(request, env, { success: true, cancelled: false, paid: true, message: "This order was already verified as paid; it cannot be cancelled by the browser." });
      const result = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE payments SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = ? WHERE paypal_order_id = ? AND status IN ('created','failed')")
        .bind(new Date().toISOString(), orderId).run();
      if (!result.success) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Could not update the cancellation record." }, 500);
      const afterCancel = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT status FROM payments WHERE paypal_order_id = ? LIMIT 1").bind(orderId).first();
      if (afterCancel?.status === "paid") return json(request, env, { success: true, cancelled: false, paid: true, message: "This order was verified as paid before cancellation could be recorded." });
      if (afterCancel?.status !== "cancelled") return json(request, env, { success: false, cancelled: false, paid: false, message: "The cancellation status could not be confirmed. Check the payment log before retrying." }, 409);
      return json(request, env, { success: true, cancelled: true, paid: false, message: "Checkout cancelled. The payment was not recorded as paid." });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/paypal/capture-order" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (!paymentOriginAllowed(request, env)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Origin not allowed." }, 403);
      if (String(env.PAYPAL_ENABLED || "false").toLowerCase() !== "true" || !env.DB || !env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID || !env.PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET || !String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN || "").trim() || String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN).trim() === "*") return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "PayPal credentials, payment storage, or exact allowed website origin are not configured." }, 503);
      const parsedBody = await readJsonLimited(request, 1000);
      if (parsedBody.error) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? "Request is too large." : "Invalid capture request." }, parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsedBody.value;
      const orderId = safeString(body.orderID, 100);
      if (!/^[A-Z0-9-]{8,100}$/i.test(orderId)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Invalid PayPal order ID." }, 400);
      const payment = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT payment_id, reference, product_id, amount, currency, status, paypal_order_id, paypal_capture_id, paid_at, mode FROM payments WHERE paypal_order_id = ? LIMIT 1").bind(orderId).first();
      if (!payment) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "This PayPal order is not registered with Marrakechpixim." }, 404);
      if (payment.status === "paid" && payment.paypal_capture_id) return json(request, env, { success: true, paid: true, reference: payment.reference, captureId: payment.paypal_capture_id, paidAt: payment.paid_at, message: "Payment was already verified." });
      const currentMode = String(env.PAYPAL_MODE || "sandbox").toLowerCase() === "live" ? "live" : "sandbox";
      if (payment.mode !== currentMode) return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "This order belongs to a different PayPal environment. Do not retry it under changed credentials; review the original environment." }, 409);
      if (payment.status === "cancelled") return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "This checkout was cancelled in the payment log. Create a new checkout if you still wish to pay." }, 409);
      const expectedProduct = PAYPAL_PRODUCTS[payment.product_id];
      const amountAllowed = expectedProduct && (payment.product_id === "digital-mini-consultation"
        ? payment.amount === expectedProduct.amount
        : payment.product_id === "project-support-donation" && expectedProduct.allowedAmounts.includes(payment.amount));
      if (!expectedProduct || !amountAllowed || payment.currency !== PAYPAL_CURRENCY) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Payment record does not match an approved server-side purpose, amount and currency." }, 409);
      try {
        const token = await paypalAccessToken(env);
        let orderData;
        try {
          // Stable idempotency key for this order: safe retries must reuse the same key.
          const captureRequestId = (await sha256Hex(`marrakechpixim-capture:${orderId}`)).slice(0, 32);
          orderData = await paypalApi(env, token, `/v2/checkout/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/capture`, { method: "POST", headers: { "PayPal-Request-Id": captureRequestId }, body: "{}" });
        } catch (captureError) {
          // If a retry arrives after PayPal captured successfully, read the authoritative order and verify it below.
          if (captureError.status !== 422 && captureError.status !== 409) throw captureError;
          orderData = await paypalApi(env, token, `/v2/checkout/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}`, { method: "GET" });
        }
        if (orderData.status !== "COMPLETED") return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "PayPal has not confirmed a completed payment. The transaction is not marked as paid." }, 409);
        const unit = (orderData.purchase_units || []).find(u => u.custom_id === payment.payment_id && u.invoice_id === payment.reference);
        const capture = unit?.payments?.captures?.find(c => c.status === "COMPLETED" && c.amount?.currency_code === payment.currency && c.amount?.value === payment.amount);
        if (!unit || unit.custom_id !== payment.payment_id || unit.reference_id !== payment.product_id || !capture) return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "PayPal confirmation did not match the registered purpose, amount and currency. The payment was not marked as paid." }, 409);
        if (env.PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID && unit.payee?.merchant_id !== env.PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID) return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "The payment recipient did not match the configured merchant account. Manual review is required." }, 409);
        const paidAt = capture.create_time || new Date().toISOString();
        const captureId = safeString(capture.id, 100);
        const update = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE payments SET status = 'paid', paypal_capture_id = ?, paid_at = ?, updated_at = ?, error_code = NULL WHERE payment_id = ? AND paypal_order_id = ? AND status IN ('created','capturing','failed')")
          .bind(captureId, paidAt, new Date().toISOString(), payment.payment_id, orderId).run();
        if (!update.success) return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "PayPal reports completion, but the local payment log could not be updated. Do not repeat payment; contact support with the order ID." }, 500);
        const saved = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT status, paypal_capture_id, paid_at FROM payments WHERE payment_id = ?").bind(payment.payment_id).first();
        if (saved?.status !== "paid" || saved.paypal_capture_id !== captureId) return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "Payment verification is pending reconciliation. Do not pay again; contact support with the order ID." }, 500);
        const notifySent = await notifyPayment(env, { reference: payment.reference, productId: payment.product_id, productName: expectedProduct.name, amount: payment.amount, currency: payment.currency, orderId, captureId, paidAt, mode: payment.mode });
        return json(request, env, { success: true, paid: true, reference: payment.reference, captureId, paidAt, notificationSent: notifySent, message: "PayPal payment verified and recorded." });
      } catch (error) {
        await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE payments SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 'paid' ELSE 'failed' END, error_code = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE payment_id = ?")
          .bind(safeString(error.paypalIssue || "CAPTURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED", 80), new Date().toISOString(), payment.payment_id).run();
        return json(request, env, { success: false, paid: false, message: "The server could not verify the PayPal capture. No success confirmation was issued. If PayPal charged you, do not pay again; contact support with your order ID." }, 502);
      }
    }

    // Public discovery through Wikidata. This is not a complete company registry and is independent of payment processing.
    if (url.pathname === "/api/company-search" && request.method === "GET") {
      const q = safeString(url.searchParams.get("q"), 160).normalize("NFC");
      if (q.length < 2) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Enter at least 2 characters to search." }, 400);
      // Bound upstream latency so a slow third-party API cannot hold the Worker request indefinitely.
      const fetchWikidataJson = async (target, timeoutMs = 6500) => {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort("Wikidata request timed out"), timeoutMs);
        try {
          const response = await fetch(target, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            headers: {
              "Accept": "application/json",
              "User-Agent": "Marrakechpixim/1.0 (mailto:Marrakechpixim@gmail.com)"
            }
          });
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Wikidata HTTP " + response.status);
          const data = await response.json();
          if (!data || typeof data !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid Wikidata response");
          return data;
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timer);
        }
      };
      try {
        const languageInput = safeString(url.searchParams.get("lang"), 8).toLowerCase();
        const allowedLanguages = new Set(["en", "fr", "es", "ar", "pt", "ru", "zh"]);
        const language = allowedLanguages.has(languageInput) ? languageInput : "en";
        const apiUrl = new URL("https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php");
        apiUrl.search = new URLSearchParams({ action: "wbsearchentities", search: q, language, uselang: language, format: "json", limit: "8", type: "item", maxlag: "5", origin: "*" }).toString();
        const searchData = await fetchWikidataJson(apiUrl.toString());
        const entities = (Array.isArray(searchData.search) ? searchData.search : [])
          .filter(x => x && /^Q\d+$/.test(String(x.id || "")))
          .slice(0, 8);
        let entityData = {};
        let detailsAvailable = true;
        if (entities.length) {
          const detailUrl = new URL("https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php");
          detailUrl.search = new URLSearchParams({ action: "wbgetentities", ids: entities.map(x => x.id).join("|"), props: "claims", format: "json", maxlag: "5", origin: "*" }).toString();
          try {
            const details = await fetchWikidataJson(detailUrl.toString(), 4500);
            entityData = details.entities && typeof details.entities === "object" ? details.entities : {};
          } catch (_) {
            // Search labels still work if the optional website-detail lookup is unavailable.
            detailsAvailable = false;
          }
        }
        const results = entities.map(x => {
          const claims = entityData[x.id]?.claims || {};
          const websiteClaim = (Array.isArray(claims.P856) ? claims.P856 : []).find(c => c?.mainsnak?.datavalue?.value);
          let website = websiteClaim ? String(websiteClaim.mainsnak.datavalue.value).trim() : "";
          if (website && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(website)) website = "https://" + website;
          try {
            const parsedWebsite = new URL(website);
            if (!/^https?:$/.test(parsedWebsite.protocol)) website = "";
          } catch (_) { website = ""; }
          return {
            id: x.id,
            label: safeString(x.label, 250),
            description: safeString(x.description, 600),
            entityUrl: "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/" + x.id,
            website
          };
        });
        return json(request, env, {
          success: true,
          provider: "Wikidata",
          query: q,
          language,
          results,
          detailsAvailable,
          note: "Public knowledge-base results are not exhaustive; verify official websites and business details independently. Search availability does not confirm a partner or payment status."
        });
      } catch (_) {
        return json(request, env, { success: false, provider: "Wikidata", message: "Worldwide search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." }, 502);
      }
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/company" && (request.method === "GET" || request.method === "HEAD")) return new Response(request.method === "HEAD" ? null : mpxCompanyOperationsPage(), { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex, nofollow", "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer", "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'", "Permissions-Policy": "camera=(), geolocation=()", "Strict-Transport-Security": "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" } });
    if (url.pathname === "/admin" && request.method === "GET") return new Response(adminPage(), { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer", "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'", "Permissions-Policy": "camera=(), geolocation=()", "Strict-Transport-Security": "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" } });
    if (url.pathname === "/admin/payments" && request.method === "GET") return new Response(paymentAdminPage(), { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer", "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex, nofollow", "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'", "Permissions-Policy": "camera=(), geolocation=()", "Strict-Transport-Security": "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" } });

    if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/payments" && request.method === "GET") {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unauthorized. Check the administrator token." }, 401);
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "D1 database is not configured." }, 503);
      const result = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT payment_id, reference, amount, currency, status, paypal_order_id, paypal_capture_id, mode, created_at, updated_at, paid_at FROM payments ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200").all();
      const payments = (result.results || []).map(p => ({ id: p.payment_id, reference: p.reference, amount: p.amount, currency: p.currency, status: p.status, orderId: p.paypal_order_id, captureId: p.paypal_capture_id, mode: p.mode, createdAt: p.created_at, updatedAt: p.updated_at, paidAt: p.paid_at }));
      return json(request, env, { success: true, payments });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/requests" && request.method === "POST") {
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Request storage is not configured yet." }, 503);
      const origin = request.headers.get("Origin") || "";
      const requestOrigin = new URL(request.url).origin;
      const rawAllowedOrigin = String(env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN || "").trim();
      const allowedOrigin = normalizeOrigin(rawAllowedOrigin);
      if (rawAllowedOrigin && (!allowedOrigin || allowedOrigin !== requestOrigin)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Request endpoint and ALLOWED_ORIGIN do not match. Configure ALLOWED_ORIGIN as the exact site origin, without a path." }, 503);
      if (origin && origin !== requestOrigin) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Origin not allowed." }, 403);
      if (origin && allowedOrigin && origin !== allowedOrigin) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Origin not allowed." }, 403);
      const contentType = String(request.headers.get("Content-Type") || "").toLowerCase();
      if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Content-Type must be application/json." }, 415);
      const parsedBody = await readJsonLimited(request, 20000);
      if (parsedBody.error) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? "Request is too large." : "Invalid request data." }, parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsedBody.value;
      const kind = safeString(body.kind, 30);
      const raw = body.fields && typeof body.fields === "object" && !Array.isArray(body.fields) ? body.fields : {};
      // Honeypot field: bots that fill it are silently rejected as a generic error.
      if (safeString(raw.companyFax, 200)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Could not submit this request. Please check the form and try again." }, 400);
      if (!ALLOWED_KINDS.has(kind)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unknown request type." }, 400);
      const fields = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
        if (!/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,59}$/.test(k)) continue;
        fields[k] = safeString(v, k.toLowerCase().includes("message") || k.toLowerCase().includes("proposal") || k.toLowerCase().includes("details") ? 4000 : 500);
      }
      const requiredByKind = {
        business: ["requestType", "requestSector", "requestName", "requestEmail", "requestMessage", "requestConsent"],
        artist: ["artistType", "artistStageName", "artistLegalName", "artistEmail", "artistCountry", "artistProposal", "artistContactConsent"],
        consultation: ["consultationKind", "consultationCategory", "consultationName", "consultationEmail", "consultationDetails", "consultationConsent"],
        newsletter: ["email", "newsletterConsent"],
        suggestion: ["suggestionType", "suggestionMessage", "suggestionConsent"],
        "partner-proposal": ["companyName", "contactNameRole", "partnerEmail", "country", "proposalType", "sector", "proposalDetails", "termsAcknowledged", "dataConsent"],
        shipment: ["senderCompany", "senderEmail", "approvedReference", "contentsType", "quantityAndPackages", "purposeAndContents", "shipmentConsent"],
        "payment-notice": ["paymentMethod", "senderEmail", "paymentAmount", "paymentDate", "paymentReference", "paymentNoticeConsent"], "platform-contact": ["requestName", "requestEmail", "requestCountry", "requestPurpose", "requestMessage", "requestConsent"]
      };
      const requiredFields = requiredByKind[kind] || [];
      if (kind === "newsletter") fields.email = safeString(fields.email || fields.newsletterEmail, 254).toLowerCase();
      for (const key of requiredFields) {
        if (!safeString(fields[key], 4000)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Please complete all required fields and consent checkboxes." }, 400);
      }
      const consentFields = {
        business: ["requestConsent"], artist: ["artistContactConsent"], consultation: ["consultationConsent"],
        newsletter: ["newsletterConsent"], suggestion: ["suggestionConsent"],
        "partner-proposal": ["termsAcknowledged", "dataConsent"], shipment: ["shipmentConsent"], "payment-notice": ["paymentNoticeConsent"], "platform-contact": ["requestConsent"]
      };
      for (const key of (consentFields[kind] || [])) {
        if (fields[key] !== "yes") return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Please confirm the required consent before submitting." }, 400);
      }
      const emailForValidation = fields.email || fields.requestEmail || fields.artistEmail || fields.consultationEmail || fields.partnerEmail || fields.senderEmail || fields.suggestionEmail || "";
      if (emailForValidation && !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(emailForValidation)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Enter a valid email address." }, 400);
      const email = safeString(fields.email || fields.requestEmail || fields.artistEmail || fields.consultationEmail || fields.partnerEmail || fields.senderEmail || fields.suggestionEmail, 254).toLowerCase();
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      // Privacy-preserving per-IP throttle: store only a SHA-256 hash, never the raw IP.
      const requestIp = request.headers.get("CF-Connecting-IP") || "unknown";
      const requestIpHash = await sha256Hex(requestIp);
      const requestWindow = new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
      const requestAttempts = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM request_attempts WHERE ip_hash = ? AND created_at > ?").bind(requestIpHash, requestWindow).first();
      if (Number(requestAttempts?.total || 0) >= 20) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Too many submissions from this connection. Please wait 10 minutes and try again." }, 429);
      const attemptSaved = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO request_attempts (ip_hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)").bind(requestIpHash, now).run();
      if (!attemptSaved.success) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Could not apply the request safety check. Please try again later." }, 500);
      // Basic duplicate throttle: same email and form type may submit once per 45 seconds.
      if (email) {
        const recent = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id FROM requests WHERE email = ? AND kind = ? AND created_at > ? LIMIT 1")
          .bind(email, kind, new Date(Date.now() - 45000).toISOString()).first();
        if (recent) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "A similar request was just received. Please wait a little before submitting again." }, 429);
      }
      const reference = makeReference();
      const result = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO requests (reference, kind, email, fields_json, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'new', ?)")
        .bind(reference, kind, email || null, JSON.stringify(fields), now).run();
      if (!result.success) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "We could not save your request. Your entries have not been cleared; please try again later." }, 500);
      const notifySent = await notifyOwner(env, { reference, kind, fields, createdAt: now });
      return json(request, env, { success: true, reference, stored: true, notificationSent: notifySent, message: "Request saved." }, 201);
    }

    // Sales register and accountant archive. All routes require ADMIN_TOKEN and D1.
    const isSalesRoute = url.pathname.startsWith("/api/admin/sales");
    if (isSalesRoute) {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, {success:false,message:"Unauthorized. Check the administrator token."},401);
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, {success:false,message:"D1 database is not configured."},503);
      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/sales" && request.method === "POST") {
        const parsed = await readJsonLimited(request, 12000);
        if (parsed.error) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:parsed.error==="too_large"?"Sale record is too large.":"Invalid JSON."},parsed.error==="too_large"?413:400);
        const b=parsed.value||{};
        const saleNumber=safeString(b.saleNumber,80).trim();
        const saleDate=safeString(b.saleDate,10).trim();
        const sectorId=safeString(b.sectorId,80).trim();
        const barcode=safeString(b.barcode,80).trim();
        const saleType=safeString(b.saleType,30).trim();
        const amount=String(b.amount??"").trim();
        const currency=safeString(b.currency,8).trim().toUpperCase();
        const paymentStatus=safeString(b.paymentStatus||"pending",20).trim();
        const counterparty=safeString(b.counterparty,160).trim();
        const invoiceReference=safeString(b.invoiceReference,120).trim();
        const notes=safeString(b.notes,2000).trim();
        if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,79}$/.test(saleNumber)) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Sale number must be 2–80 characters using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, slash or hyphen."},400);
        if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(saleDate)||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(saleDate+"T00:00:00Z"))) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"A valid sale date is required."},400);
        if(!sectorId) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Sector ID is required."},400);
        if(!["sale","commission","service","refund","other"].includes(saleType)) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Invalid sale type."},400);
        if(!/^(0|[1-9]\d{0,11})(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(amount)) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Enter a valid non-negative amount with up to two decimal places."},400);
        if(!/^[A-Z]{3,8}$/.test(currency)) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Invalid currency code."},400);
        if(!["pending","paid","part_paid","refunded","cancelled"].includes(paymentStatus)) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Invalid payment status."},400);
        const now=new Date().toISOString(), month=saleDate.slice(0,7);
        const saved=await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO sales_records (sale_number,sale_date,accounting_month,sector_id,barcode,sale_type,amount,currency,counterparty,invoice_reference,payment_status,notes,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(sale_number) DO NOTHING")
          .bind(saleNumber,saleDate,month,sectorId||null,barcode||null,saleType,amount,currency,counterparty||null,invoiceReference||null,paymentStatus,notes||null,now,now).run();
        if(!saved.success||Number(saved.meta?.changes||0)===0) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Could not save: this sale number may already exist. Search for it instead of duplicating it."},409);
        return json(request,env,{success:true,sale:{saleNumber,saleDate,accountingMonth:month,sectorId,barcode,saleType,amount,currency,paymentStatus,counterparty,invoiceReference,notes},message:"Sale record saved in D1."},201);
      }
      if(url.pathname==="/api/admin/sales-files" && request.method==="POST"){
        if(!env.MPX_FILES) return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Private file storage is not configured. Create a Cloudflare R2 bucket and bind it as MPX_FILES."},503);
        let form;try{form=await request.formData()}catch(_){return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Expected a multipart file upload."},400)}
        const saleNumber=safeString(form.get("saleNumber"),80).trim(), documentType=safeString(form.get("documentType"),30).trim();const file=form.get("file");
        if(!saleNumber||!file||typeof file.arrayBuffer!=="function")return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Sale number and file are required."},400);
        if(!["invoice","receipt","contract","delivery","refund","other"].includes(documentType))return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Invalid document type."},400);
        if(file.size<1||file.size>10485760)return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"File must be between 1 byte and 10 MB."},413);
        const sale=await env.DB.prepare("SELECT sale_number FROM sales_records WHERE sale_number=?").bind(saleNumber).first();if(!sale)return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Sale number not found. Save the sale record first."},404);
        const fileName=safeString(file.name,180).replace(/[\\/\\\\]/g,"_").replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._ -]/g,"_")||"document";
        const ext=(fileName.split(".").pop()||"").toLowerCase();if(!["pdf","png","jpg","jpeg","webp","doc","docx","xls","xlsx","csv","txt"].includes(ext))return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"File type is not allowed."},415);
        const key="sales/"+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)+"/"+encodeURIComponent(saleNumber)+"/"+crypto.randomUUID()+"-"+fileName;
        const bytes=await file.arrayBuffer();const contentType=safeString(file.type,100)||"application/octet-stream";
        await env.MPX_FILES.put(key,bytes,{httpMetadata:{contentType,contentDisposition:"attachment; filename=\\\""+fileName.replace(/[\\\"\\r\\n]/g,"_")+"\\\""},customMetadata:{saleNumber,documentType,fileName,uploadedAt:new Date().toISOString()}});
        const now=new Date().toISOString();const saved=await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO sales_documents (sale_number,object_key,file_name,document_type,content_type,size_bytes,uploaded_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").bind(saleNumber,key,fileName,documentType,contentType,file.size,now).run();
        if(!saved.success){await env.MPX_FILES.delete(key);return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"File could not be registered. Upload rolled back."},500)}
        return json(request,env,{success:true,saleNumber,fileName,documentType,sizeBytes:file.size,stored:"private R2"},201);
      }
      if(url.pathname==="/api/admin/sales" && request.method==="GET"){
        const q=safeString(url.searchParams.get("q")||"",100).trim();const month=safeString(url.searchParams.get("month")||"",7).trim();
        if(month&&!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month))return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Month must use YYYY-MM format."},400);
        let query="SELECT * FROM sales_records WHERE 1=1", binds=[];if(month){query+=" AND accounting_month=?";binds.push(month)}if(q){query+=" AND (sale_number LIKE ? OR sector_id LIKE ? OR barcode LIKE ? OR invoice_reference LIKE ? OR counterparty LIKE ?)";const pat="%"+q+"%";binds.push(pat,pat,pat,pat,pat)}query+=" ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500";
        let stmt=env.DB.prepare(query);if(binds.length)stmt=stmt.bind(...binds);const result=await stmt.all();const sales=[];
        for(const r of (result.results||[])){const docs=await env.DB.prepare("SELECT file_name,document_type,content_type,size_bytes,uploaded_at FROM sales_documents WHERE sale_number=? ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC").bind(r.sale_number).all();sales.push({saleNumber:r.sale_number,saleDate:r.sale_date,accountingMonth:r.accounting_month,sectorId:r.sector_id,barcode:r.barcode,saleType:r.sale_type,amount:r.amount,currency:r.currency,counterparty:r.counterparty,invoiceReference:r.invoice_reference,paymentStatus:r.payment_status,notes:r.notes,createdAt:r.created_at,documents:(docs.results||[]).map(d=>({fileName:d.file_name,documentType:d.document_type,contentType:d.content_type,sizeBytes:d.size_bytes,uploadedAt:d.uploaded_at}))})}
        return json(request,env,{success:true,count:sales.length,sales});
      }
      if(url.pathname==="/api/admin/sales/export.csv" && request.method==="GET"){
        const month=safeString(url.searchParams.get("month")||"",7).trim();if(!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month))return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Choose a valid month using YYYY-MM."},400);
        const rows=await env.DB.prepare("SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_documents d WHERE d.sale_number=s.sale_number) AS document_count FROM sales_records s WHERE accounting_month=? ORDER BY sale_date,sale_number").bind(month).all();
        const csvCell=v=>'"'+String(v??"").replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';const head=["sale_number","sale_date","accounting_month","sector_id","barcode","sale_type","amount","currency","counterparty","invoice_reference","payment_status","notes","document_count","created_at"];
        const lines=[head.map(csvCell).join(","),...(rows.results||[]).map(r=>[r.sale_number,r.sale_date,r.accounting_month,r.sector_id,r.barcode,r.sale_type,r.amount,r.currency,r.counterparty,r.invoice_reference,r.payment_status,r.notes,r.document_count,r.created_at].map(csvCell).join(","))];
        return new Response("\uFEFF"+lines.join("\r\n"),{status:200,headers:{...corsHeaders(request,env),"Content-Type":"text/csv; charset=utf-8","Content-Disposition":"attachment; filename=Marrakechpixim-sales-"+month+".csv","Cache-Control":"no-store","X-Content-Type-Options":"nosniff"}});
      }
      return json(request,env,{success:false,message:"Not found."},404);
    }

    // Protected incident log and automatic error statistics for the administrator.
    if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/errors" && request.method === "GET") {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unauthorized." }, 401);
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "D1 database is not configured." }, 503);
      const month = safeString(url.searchParams.get("month") || "", 7).trim();
      if (month && !/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Month must use YYYY-MM format." }, 400);
      let stmt = month
        ? env.DB.prepare("SELECT id,path,method,error_message,http_status,created_at,notified_at FROM system_errors WHERE substr(created_at,1,7)=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200").bind(month)
        : env.DB.prepare("SELECT id,path,method,error_message,http_status,created_at,notified_at FROM system_errors ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200");
      const [rows, counts] = await Promise.all([stmt.all(), env.DB.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN http_status>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS server_errors, MAX(created_at) AS latest FROM system_errors").first()]);
      return json(request, env, { success: true, statistics: { total: counts?.total || 0, serverErrors: counts?.server_errors || 0, latest: counts?.latest || null }, errors: rows.results || [] });
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/requests" && request.method === "GET") {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unauthorized. Check the administrator token." }, 401);
      if (!env.DB) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "D1 database is not configured." }, 503);
      const status = url.searchParams.get("status") || "all";
      let result;
      if (status === "all") result = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id, reference, kind, email, fields_json, status, created_at FROM requests ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200").all();
      else if (ALLOWED_STATUSES.has(status)) result = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id, reference, kind, email, fields_json, status, created_at FROM requests WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200").bind(status).all();
      else return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Invalid status filter." }, 400);
      const requests = (result.results || []).map(r => ({ id: r.id, reference: r.reference, kind: r.kind, email: r.email, fields: JSON.parse(r.fields_json || "{}"), status: r.status, createdAt: r.created_at }));
      return json(request, env, { success: true, requests });
    }

    const statusMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/admin\/requests\/(\d+)\/status$/);
    if (statusMatch && request.method === "PATCH") {
      if (!env.ADMIN_TOKEN || request.headers.get("Authorization") !== `Bearer ${env.ADMIN_TOKEN}`) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Unauthorized." }, 401);
      const parsedBody = await readJsonLimited(request, 1000);
      if (parsedBody.error) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? "Request is too large." : "Invalid JSON." }, parsedBody.error === "too_large" ? 413 : 400);
      const body = parsedBody.value;
      const status = safeString(body.status, 30);
      if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.has(status)) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Invalid request status." }, 400);
      const result = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE requests SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?").bind(status, new Date().toISOString(), Number(statusMatch[1])).run();
      if (!result.success || result.meta?.changes === 0) return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Request not found or status unchanged." }, 404);
      return json(request, env, { success: true, status });
    }
    // Serve website assets from this same Worker origin after API routes.
    if (env.ASSETS && (request.method === "GET" || request.method === "HEAD")) {
      return env.ASSETS.fetch(request);
    }
    return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "Not found." }, 404);
    } catch (error) {
      // Persistent incident record; best-effort only, so logging failure never masks the original error.
      const incidentAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const incidentPath = String(url.pathname || "/").slice(0, 240);
      const incidentMethod = String(request.method || "GET").slice(0, 12);
      const incidentMessage = String(error?.message || error || "Unknown server error").replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ").slice(0, 240);
      try { console.error("Marrakechpixim server error", { path: incidentPath, method: incidentMethod, message: incidentMessage, at: incidentAt }); } catch (_) {}
      try {
        if (env.DB) {
          const insert = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO system_errors (path,method,error_message,http_status,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)")
            .bind(incidentPath, incidentMethod, incidentMessage, 500, incidentAt).run();
          // Optional email alert. Requires RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM_EMAIL and NOTIFY_EMAIL secrets/vars.
          // Deduplicate email alerts per path for 15 minutes; every incident remains in the log.
          if (insert?.success && env.RESEND_API_KEY && env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL && env.NOTIFY_EMAIL) {
            const recent = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM system_errors WHERE path=? AND notified_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at>=?")
              .bind(incidentPath, new Date(Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()).first();
            if (!(recent?.n > 0)) {
              const alert = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", { method: "POST", headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${env.RESEND_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ from: env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, to: [env.NOTIFY_EMAIL], subject: "Marrakechpixim: server error alert", text: `A server error occurred.\nTime: ${incidentAt}\nPath: ${incidentPath}\nMethod: ${incidentMethod}\nHTTP: 500\nMessage: ${incidentMessage}\n\nReview the protected /api/admin/errors endpoint and Cloudflare Worker Logs.` }) });
              if (alert.ok) await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE system_errors SET notified_at=? WHERE id=?").bind(incidentAt, insert.meta?.last_row_id).run();
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (logError) { try { console.error("Marrakechpixim incident persistence/notification failed", String(logError?.message || logError).slice(0, 120)); } catch (_) {} }
      return json(request, env, { success: false, message: "The server could not complete this request. The error was logged when the database is configured. Please retry shortly." }, 500);
    }
  }
};


/*
D1 MIGRATION — run once in Cloudflare D1 SQL console; do not drop existing tables:

-- Run this migration once in the existing Cloudflare D1 database used by Marrakechpixim.
-- Do not drop or recreate the existing requests table.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requests (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT,
  fields_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('new','reviewing','replied','closed')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_requests_email_kind_created ON requests(email, kind, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_requests_status_created ON requests(status, created_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_attempts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_request_attempts_ip_created ON request_attempts(ip_hash, created_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  payment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('creating','created','capturing','paid','failed','cancelled')),
  paypal_order_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  paypal_capture_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('sandbox','live')),
  error_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  paid_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_ip_created ON payments(ip_hash, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_status_created ON payments(status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payments_reference ON payments(reference);

-- Marrakechpixim Platform Memory (additive; run only after backing up the existing D1 database)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platform_memory (
  memory_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin'
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platform_memory_history (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  memory_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  changed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  changed_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',
  UNIQUE(memory_key, revision)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_platform_memory_history_key_revision ON platform_memory_history(memory_key, revision DESC);


-- Marrakechpixim sales register and monthly accounting archive. Additive migration only.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_records (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 sale_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 sale_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 accounting_month TEXT NOT NULL,
 sector_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 barcode TEXT,
 sale_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sale_type IN ('sale','commission','service','refund','other')),
 amount TEXT NOT NULL,
 currency TEXT NOT NULL,
 counterparty TEXT,
 invoice_reference TEXT,
 payment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_status IN ('pending','paid','part_paid','refunded','cancelled')),
 notes TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_records_month_date ON sales_records(accounting_month,sale_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_records_sector_barcode ON sales_records(sector_id,barcode);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_documents (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 sale_number TEXT NOT NULL,
 object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 document_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
 uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY (sale_number) REFERENCES sales_records(sale_number)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_documents_sale_uploaded ON sales_documents(sale_number,uploaded_at);

-- Server incident log. Additive only; supports automatic statistics and optional email alerts.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_errors (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 path TEXT NOT NULL,
 method TEXT NOT NULL,
 error_message TEXT NOT NULL,
 http_status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 notified_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_errors_created ON system_errors(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_errors_path_created ON system_errors(path,created_at DESC);
